ResearchProjectDef.label: witcher traditions
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study the scattered records of the witcher schools — how they hunt monsters, bargain under the Law of Surprise, and why their alchemy kills ordinary men. Unlocks witcher-specific caravan interactions and monster contracts from neighboring settlements.

ResearchProjectDef.label: trial of grasses
ResearchProjectDef.description:
The first and most brutal of the witcher trials. Subjects are dosed with an alchemical brew of healroot, psychoid, and hops. The mutagens that survive the immune response remake the body: dense connective tissue, accelerated healing, sharper night vision. Only about three in ten endure the fever.
Once researched, this trial becomes available as an operation in the Health tab.

ResearchProjectDef.label: trial of dreams
ResearchProjectDef.description: A second trial reserved for those who survived the grasses. Subjects drink psychite tea laced with smokeleaf and are guided through nightmare visions while their nervous system is rewired. About seven in ten survive. Survivors gain pain resistance, emotional flatness, and sharpened reflexes.

ResearchProjectDef.label: additional mutagens
ResearchProjectDef.description: An experimental second dose of mutagens, administered to a master witcher. The brew pushes existing gifts to their extreme tier and may grant agelessness — but only about one in ten survive. Those who endure become faster, tougher, and harder to kill than any witcher before them.

ResearchProjectDef.label: trial of mountains
ResearchProjectDef.description: The final trial. A fully trained witcher may take monster-slaying contracts — beasts sighted on nearby tiles that must be hunted down and killed. Fulfil enough contracts to prove mastery and become a master witcher.
